t: Purchasing Specialist - City of Turlock (Working for Us\Job Descriptions)
s: Under general supervision from the Purchasing Supervisor, the Purchasing Specialist performs a variety of technical procurement and related services within the City's purchasing division; review purchase orders, purchase requisitions, bids, specifications, and invoices for accuracy and appropriateness; coordinate the purchase of supplies, materials, equipment and services in order to support and enhance the delivery of City services; monitor contracts to ensure compliance with purchasing and related requirements; prepare and maintain a variety of purchasing related records, files, lists and forms; respond to inquiries and provide information regarding purchasing activities, and performs other work as required.
